description: Details Be the first owner of one of the New Thorn Mercury 40 bikes , equipped with Rohloff - Gunmetal - 61L with straight bars - we had this frame sent over to us ahead of the rest , this is a beautiful sporty responsive bike and would be ideal for sportier rides like Audaxes , commuting , weekend trips away , longer day rides or a full on European tour . This bike will suit riders of 1795mm (5Ft 10in) – 1945 mm (6ft 5in) approx. Virtual top tube length 615mm . Clearance over mid top tube 850mm. The position can be altered to suit the rider. If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk.A showroom visit can be arranged , give us a call. Thorn Mercury 40 61L Gunmetal Frame 858 tubing & EVO Carbon ISO Disc Gravel / Audax Fork - 700c 1 1/8" Ahead - A613D Wheels : Front: Shimano Front Hub - HB-M6000 Deore C/Lock Disc - Black - 32H, Rims. Thorn 27.5" 584 Rim w/ CNC Sidewall -Black - 32H Rear Thorn 27.5" 584 Rim w/ CNC Sidewall -Black - 32H Rear: Rohloff Speedhub 500/14 CC 14 Spd Gear Hub, black 32H 19T Schwalbe G-One Tubeless Easy HS473 Folding Tyre - 27.5 x 1.50, 40-584 with Schwalbe SV21 presta inner tubes 650B/27.5" tyres Transmission : Thorn 104/64 PCD Triple Crankset MK2 - 4 Arm Black 175mm, Thorn 104mm BCD 4 Arm Reversible Single Chainring 3/32 Inch - Black 45T Rohloff Speedhub 500/14 CC 14 Spd Gear Hub 32h Black with DISC fitting inc. 19 T Sprocket (non splined carrier) . KMC E1 Rohloff Compatible 1/2 Inch x 3/32 Chain Brakes : Front brake: TRP Spyke Mechanical disc brakes with Shimano SLX SM-RT66 6 bolt disc Rotor 180mm rotor Rear brake : TRP mechanical disc brake with IS Adapter-and Hope Rohloff 4 bolt Rotor for Rohloff hub 160mm Shimano Deore XT- BL- T780 V brake Levers- Black Finishing Kit : Thorn MK3 Flat Track Bars - 10 Deg - 25.4mm Clamp - 580mm - Black Kalloy AS-009 UNO 1 1/8" Ahead Stem +17 Deg - 25.4mm Clamp - Black- 110mm Ergon GP5-L Anatomic Grips - Large - Black SKS Chromoplastic Mudguards 700c/27.5 x P55 - Black Velo Deluxe Sports mens Saddle - Black 1 Profile bottle cages Shimano PD - GR500 Flat Pedals- Black Tubus Vega rear rack The bike specification is fixed as this bike is already built, any upgrades would be charged in full and the removed parts supplied with the bike loose, no discounts are available.
